annotations.title: Audit a page for AI search

description: Check one page the way AI assistants and AI search see it: may OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, PerplexityBot and Googlebot read it (robots.txt rule and a request with each user agent), is it indexable and quotable (noindex, nosnippet), how much text is in the HTML without JavaScript, title, meta description, headings, structured data, updated date, canonical, sitemap listing, robots.txt health, llms.txt and response time. Use this for "why doesn't ChatGPT cite this page?", "is my pricing page ready for AI search?" or before publishing a page. Returns problems with their fix first, then improvements; says plainly when nothing needs fixing.

url.description: The page's address, for example https://example.com/pricing (a bare domain audits the homepage)

name: audit_page_for_ai
